candidate_interval.rule: one-sided bounds at alpha, conservative: lower = min(t, cluster bootstrap), upper = max(t, cluster bootstrap)
candidate_interval.caveat: Benchmark selection is adaptive over up to 8 candidate rounds, so these bootstrap and t intervals are decision/uncertainty summaries, not fresh-unseen confirmation. This record is not an independent final generalization proof.

dregon_cruise.cluster_unit: independently recorded trajectory session (one 4 s cruise window each)

real_arm.role: protocol reproduction check on the real arm, never a gate input

dregon_cruise.paired_improvement_note: the frozen per-recording baseline MAEs live only in the gitignored results/revised_phase/baseline_v2/calibration.json; without them the paired E_baseline - E_candidate interval of revised_eval.dregon_pit_gate cannot be reproduced, so the decisive one-sided 95 % instrument is applied to the candidate's own recording-level mean against the frozen scalar target

likelihood.units: nats/s of unique observed material (lower is better)

bars.rule: PARITY = the legacy previous-best bar on BOTH HPPNet numbers; STRETCH = the frozen 0.70-gap DREGON target with Michael's parity bar unchanged

michaels.quantity: equal-regime mean PIT MAE over standby/ramp/cruise (ratio of means)
